lines: The room looked brighter after the walls
were painted a pale shade of yellow.
It did not become any larger,
but people found it easier to move around.
We also removed a table near the entrance
and placed the signs at eye level.
These changes were inexpensive,
yet they made the space feel more welcoming.
Next month, we will ask regular visitors
which part of the new arrangement works best.
